profile: steplength: Steplength, also called learning rate, is the size of the step used in local optimization and is associated with descent directions. A common alternative to fixed steplength rules is a diminishing steplength rule, which shrinks the size at each step. The same steplength may be used for multiple runs.

draft.profile: steplength: Steplength, also called learning rate, is the size of the step used in local optimization, and it is associated with descent directions. A fixed steplength keeps the same value throughout optimization; a diminishing steplength rule shrinks the size at each step. The same steplength may be used for multiple runs. Steplength appears with descent directions, diminishing steplength schemes, convergence, and cost function history plots.
